messages:
marta: Heads-up — audit logs show a token rotation path that temporarily granted broader scopes during reissue. saw an embeddings write call with 'model:all' scope for ~45s after rotation. @kevin can you look?
kevin: ack. can you paste the log lines / request ids?
marta: pasted below 
```
2026-03-18T21:12:07Z rotation.start id=rot-9f3a service=kms-proxy key=kp-phi user=svc-embed-reissue
2026-03-18T21:12:19Z token.issue id=tok-7b2a user=svc-embed-reissue scopes=[model:all,route:embed/write] request_id=req-9921
2026-03-18T21:12:52Z token.replace id=tok-7b2a->tok-7c3b user=svc-embed-reissue scopes=[route:embed/write] request_id=req-9937
2026-03-18T21:12:55Z api.call id=req-9941 user=svc-embed-reissue endpoint=/v1/embeddings model=text-embed-variant action=write
```
kevin: hmm — looks like the intermediate token (tok-7b2a) had model:all for ~33s. rotation flow should never issue broader scopes.
ashley: tagging infra: the rotation service talks to policy-assembler, which should synthesize exact scopes. my quick hunch: fallback config allowed 'inherit:parent' on missing metadata and fell through to service-level default (model:all).
sam: i can repro locally — if policy-assembler fails to fetch model allowlist, it emits a permissive default. happens when metadata cache misses coincide with KMS latency.
sec-bot: alert: scope-breach-detected rot-9f3a affected 4 requests. elevated to P2.
kevin: mitigation: revoke tok-7b2a and any tokens issued during rot-9f3a window. also rotate service principal creds for svc-embed-reissue. i pushed a short script to revoke by prefix.
marta: doing revocation now. will notify support for customer impact check.
ashley: short-term fix: make policy-assembler fail-closed (deny) instead of inheriting root scope. i'll draft a patch and a config flag. needs quick review.
kevin: add unit test for cache-miss path + integration test with KMS simulated latency. also add an audit check that rejects any token.issue containing model:all + rotation context tag.
sam: noted. i'll add a regression test to the rotation e2e harness.
infra-bot: deploy request created: infra/patch/p-394 -> staging. approvers: kevin, ashley.
marta: next steps: 1) confirm revocations completed 2) close P2 after no further scope anomalies for 24h 3) prod hotfix to make fail-closed + tests 4) postmortem draft. can someone own the postmortem?
kevin: i'll own the postmortem. can we include a timeline + decision logs + audit search query?
marta: yes — audit query: "service:token.issue rotation.id:rot-9f3a AND scopes: model:all". put that in the doc.
ashley: I'll open the PR for fail-closed + add feature toggle so we can roll back if it causes false denies.
sam: i pushed the e2e test branch. will link PR after infra staging run.
sec-bot: reminder: ensure KMS rotation metrics (latency, 99p) are alerted — added new check threshold.
marta: thanks team. filing incident ticket and pinging product for customer notifications. :white_check_mark:
